title: Water - Max. Suction Flow Velocities vs. Pipe Size
description: Recommended maximum water flow velocities on suction sides of pumps. Keep suction fluid flow speed below specified values to avoid capacity problems, cavitation, and high power consumption.

components.content: Calculate Flow Velocity from Flow Rate and Pipe Size

## Notes

**Key Points:**
- Capacity problems, cavitation, and high power consumption in pumps often result from suction side conditions
- As a rule of thumb, keep suction fluid flow speed below the recommended values in the table above
- Use the calculator above to determine your system's flow velocity for a given flow rate and pipe size
- Compare your calculated velocity against the maximum recommended velocity for your pipe size

**Related Topics:**
- Cavitation and NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) - important for understanding suction-side performance
